info.name: LedgerOne - Organization
info.description:
Organization module API collection (Tenant, Company, Branch, Department). Reflects the implementation exactly as shipped in apps/api/src/shared/organization — including known gaps (no TenantSettings/TenantSubscription create endpoint, so those rows never exist for a freshly created tenant; tenant context for Company/Branch/Department is resolved via the X-Tenant-Id header rather than auth-derived, since no tenant-resolution middleware exists yet). Pair with the LedgerOne - Local Dev environment in this same folder.

Run order for a full happy-path pass, top to bottom: Tenant > Company > Branch > Department > Tenant Lifecycle (Deactivate). Each folder chains off collection variables set by its own 'Success' requests ({{tenantUuid}}, {{companyUuid}}, {{branchUuid}}, {{departmentUuid}}) — run folders in order, do not run negative-path requests out of order relative to their folder's Create/Get/Update sequence.
